_comment: Per-card sub-signal detail rendered by SignalCardsGrid when expanded. Structure follows docs/mvp/engine/02_regime_engine_specification.md v2.1 §8 (Signal Registry — 4 groups x 11 signals: BTC Structure 4 / Macro Environment 3 / Institutional Demand 1 / Relative Strength 3). Values, states, points and copy are GENERATED every cycle by apps/web/scripts/market-refresh/run.mjs + generate.mjs and reconciled by the --check drift gate. NOTE (2026-08-24): this comment is deliberately CYCLE-AGNOSTIC. It previously restated one cycle's anchors and verdicts — including 'ETF-01 is UNAVAILABLE per §10.1 (CoinGlass routes 404, Farside Cloudflare-blocked)' — which stayed here for two months after ETF-01 moved to the Polygon shares-outstanding ledger and went ACTIVE. Per-cycle facts live in the data below and in run-archive.jsonl; do not restate them here. _translation_status tracks non-EN content review state.

lead.en: Macro conditions are mixed: liquidity on the supportive side, the dollar and yields on the restrictive side. The dollar climbed back above its 20 week trend this week. Money has not got cheaper. Liquidity keeps expanding.

lead.es: Las condiciones macro son mixtas: la liquidez del lado favorable, el dólar y los rendimientos del lado restrictivo. El dólar volvió a superar su tendencia de 20 semanas esta semana. El dinero no se ha abaratado. La liquidez sigue en expansión.
lead.de: Die Makro-Bedingungen sind gemischt: die Liquidität auf der unterstützenden Seite, der Dollar und die Renditen auf der restriktiven Seite. Der Dollar ist diese Woche wieder über seinen 20-Wochen-Trend gestiegen. Geld ist nicht günstiger geworden. Die Liquidität wächst weiter.

depth.en: The dollar closed at 120.33 against a 119.37 trend, 0.80% above, after sitting 0.87% below it a week earlier. That is a fresh crossing. The US 10 year at 5.17% holds above its own 4.70% trend. M2 is up 5.7% over the year and added roughly $125bn on the month.
depth.pt-BR: O índice amplo do dólar fechou em 120,33 contra uma tendência de 119,37, 0,80% acima, depois de estar 0,87% abaixo uma semana antes. O rompimento é recente. O juro americano de 10 anos, a 5,17%, segue acima da tendência de 20 semanas (4,70%). A oferta monetária M2 dos EUA cresce 5,7% em 12 meses e somou cerca de 125 bilhões de dólares no mês.
depth.es: El índice amplio del dólar cerró en 120,33 frente a una tendencia de 119,37, un 0,80% por encima, tras estar un 0,87% por debajo una semana antes. El cruce es reciente. El rendimiento estadounidense a 10 años, en 5,17%, sigue por encima de su tendencia de 20 semanas (4,70%). La masa monetaria M2 de EE. UU. crece un 5,7% interanual y sumó cerca de 125 mil millones de dólares en el mes.
depth.de: Der breite Dollar-Index schloss bei 120,33 gegenüber einem Trend von 119,37, 0,80% darüber, nachdem er eine Woche zuvor 0,87% darunter lag. Der Trendbruch ist frisch. Die 10-jährige US-Rendite hält sich mit 5,17% über ihrem 20-Wochen-Trend (4,70%). Die US-Geldmenge M2 wächst 5,7% im Jahresvergleich und kam im Monat um rund 125 Mrd. US-Dollar hinzu.
